# discord_server_vanity_url (Data Source)

Reads a server's vanity invite and how many times it has been used. The server needs the `VANITY_URL` feature and the bot the Manage Server permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_server_vanity_url" "main" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}

output "vanity_invite" {
  value = data.discord_server_vanity_url.main.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Vanity invite code, or null when none is set.
- `url` (String) Invite URL, `https://discord.gg/<code>`, or null when no code is set.
- `uses` (Number) Number of times the vanity invite has been used.
